title: Check yourself: The extraction system: where the pipeline can lie

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: In the example run, a scanned invoice names its vendor but holds no total anywhere in its text, and the model returns the total as null. What does the pipeline do with that document?

options.text: Retry it once with the error attached, since a second look may still find a figure there
options.says: Ruled out because the retry covers only what a second look can fix: "A value that the document does not contain stays absent however often it is asked for."

options.text: Send it to a person after one attempt, as no retry supplies what the page lacks
options.says: A missing value is routed, not retried.

options.text: Compute the figure from the line items instead, since the lines imply what the total should be, and mark the record as valid
options.says: Ruled out because the status comes from the checks and not from a guess: "The status is derived from the checks, and the model's own opinion plays no part."

options.text: Fail it at once and discard the vendor that the scan did manage to read
options.says: Ruled out because a missing value is not a failure of the document: "It is `needs_review` when the only open matters are a value the page lacks or a conflict that the model flagged, and neither is retried."

questions.stem: The example run reports three valid documents, all correct, out of six that were sent. Which pair of figures does an honest report give?

options.text: A full hundred percent, with nothing else reported alongside it
options.says: Ruled out because the denominator is every document: "A document that failed is a document the customer sent."

options.text: Half of everything received and all of the accepted ones, with the gap stated
options.says: The two figures and the gap are the report.

options.text: Half of everything received, with the accepted-only figure left out of the report
options.says: Ruled out because the validated figure is a different figure and not an irrelevant one: "The figure on the validated ones alone is a different figure and is always at least as high."

options.text: Three quarters, the mean of the two figures, reported alone
options.says: Ruled out because the figures are not blended: "The accuracy of a run is the share of all documents whose delivered record is correct."

questions.stem: A pipeline on Claude Sonnet 5.5 must make sure that an extraction tool is used on every request, and it forces the tool through `tool_choice`. What happens, and what does the documentation recommend instead?

options.text: The call works, but cached message blocks are processed again from the start
options.says: Ruled out because the request does not get as far as the cache: "Not every model and setting supports forced tool use."

options.text: The tool is used, and the text before the tool call is dropped
options.says: Ruled out because the request does not run: "On Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1, `any` and `tool` return a 400 error".

options.text: The call fails with a 400 error, and `auto` with strict schemas replaces it
options.says: On the models in the documentation's table, forcing is refused and the replacement is named.

options.text: The setting is ignored, and the model chooses whichever tool it likes best
options.says: Ruled out because a setting that the API cannot honour is rejected and not ignored: "`any` and `tool` return a 400 error, and the documented replacement is `auto` with strict tool use or structured outputs".
